name: Rising
audio: a deep rumble and a low choral swell, glass chiming softly; no speech
world: The Sundering Scar is alive: ash and glass shards drift, glowing cracks pulse, spectral wisps rise, ravens and bats wheel overhead and the pale dawn light shifts across the crater.

actions.beat: The glowing seams of the black glass crater pulse and the {{MAGIC}} sigil burns brighter; ravens and bats lift in a wheeling cloud as ash drifts upward.
{{She}} rises slowly and weightlessly out of the cracked glass, arms lowering, palms opening, shadows unfurling from {{her}} shoulders like folded wings.
{{Her}} eyes open and ignite with {{MAGIC}} light; {{she}} turns {{her}} gaze to the camera, calm, newborn and commanding, as the ash and glass shards drift back down.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
